{{Quote|Master, what's a bongo?"<br />"A transport, I hope.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="tpm">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
A '''tribubble bongo''', also called a '''Gungan bongo submarine''', was a bio-engineered [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Bongo_ep1ig.png|thumb|left|180px|Bongo cross-section]]
Bongos were handcrafted [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] vessels, built around a coral-like skeleton [[Water/Legends|underwater]]. Each one was unique, due to being made individually. The bongo's hull was strong, though could be damaged by some of the creatures in Naboo's oceans. Bongos were in fact based on the creatures found underwater, and thus many of them resembled squids or other such animals. Bongos were equipped with an electrical power plant and a guidance system. Their capacities ranged from one to many occupants. Those capable of holding many passengers were known as [[Heyblibber/Legends|heyblibbers]].

The bongo's propulsion system was based on long tentacles at the aft of the vehicle. These tentacles pushed the bongo forward. The vessel was also equipped with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] to push it through specially designed bays in Gungan [[City/Legends|cities]]. The bongo had a unique buoyancy system; when the vessel went underwater, special chambers release oil, which increased the vehicle's density. To surface, the oil was absorbed.

Bongos were very versatile, and fulfilled many functions, from carrying passengers to cargo. The Gungans based their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] designs on the bongo.

==History==
[[File:Gunganbongo.jpg|thumb|180px|A damaged bongo floats on the surface of the water.]]

The first bongos were probably invented by a tribe known as the [[Bongomeken Collective]]. Millennia later, they evolved into the [[Otoh Gunga Bongameken Cooperative/Legends|Otoh Gunga Bongameken Cooperative]]. They ranged from tiny, single-person craft to the large heyblibbers used for long journeys.

Bongos were handcrafted, ensuring that each craft was unique. A bongo was built around an organic coral-like skeleton bred in special underwater fields by Gungan designers. This skeleton formed the bongo's hull and was strong, though not durable enough to withstand [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killer]] attacks. This made it prone to damage by sea monsters encountered in the watery depths of Naboo.

While the Gungans produced much of the technology needed for bongo creation, electronics and specialized equipment like metal cargo containers had to be purchased from the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]. Gungan traders procured such items from the Naboo in exchange for foodstuffs and medicine.

Bongos were incredibly versatile and could be built for many functions. Cargo bongos featured cargo holds instead of passenger modules, while a [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Army]] transport bongo could carry about five armed passengers. Monobubble racing bongos were also produced, and bongo technology even enabled the Gungans to construct [[Starship/Legends|starships]], which they used to colonize the Naboo [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]].

Bongo technology inspired Gungan engineers in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] to create the [[gondola skimmersub]], based on bongo designs. As [[locab plasma]], a component of the bongo, was scarce in Lamaredd, the gondola used an alternate technology.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

During the Invasion of Naboo, Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn, via a Jedi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], got Boss [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]] to agree to let them use a bongo to go through Naboo's core and arrive at [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] so they could rescue Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]. However, the bongo was damaged by an opee sea killer&mdash;which briefly bit into the vehicle when capturing it to eat, only releasing it when it itself was devoured by a [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|sando aqua monster]]&mdash;and eventually lost power as a result within a [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish's]] lair. Upon arriving at the channel at Theed, they were forced to ditch the craft after they parked it too close to the current of one of Theed's waterfalls.<ref name="tpm" />

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
During the Galactic Civil War, a [[Unidentified Gungan Bongo pilot|Gungan]] utilized a bongo to escort a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] ''[[StarSpeeder 1000]]'' over to a Rebel hangar on Naboo. Similar to the Jedi before him, he was ambushed by an opee sea killer and escaped with the help of a sando aqua monster.
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
Early design concepts of the Gungan bongo resembled an organic-looking diving bell before [[Doug Chiang]] hit upon the idea of the squid-like propeller assembly. An unused concept for a large underwater passenger transport featured the manta-like silhouette. When the Episode I story changed so that the passenger transport was written out, the manta shape was incorporated into the bongo's look.<ref name="db" />
